reviews.cohesion: One validation command owns relocation source generation, assembly, and evidence checks for every supported profile.
reviews.extraction_decision: Assembly and profile helpers are already separated; splitting the coordinating transaction would duplicate temporary-tree and evidence state.
reviews.public_api_control: scripts.run exposes one stable validation.relocation_test command while focused unit tests cover its path and operand transformations.

reviews.cohesion: One reproducible import transaction parses, normalizes, validates, and writes a complete sibling-source set.
reviews.extraction_decision: The importer is workflow-only and its output is reviewed and rebuilt; splitting its stateful pipeline would weaken atomicity.
